batch: C03d.1 finite current integrals and explicit primitive boundaries
source_hash_scope: Working-tree bytes for every implementation-commit file and dependency/toolchain locks.

implementation.mathematics: For n>0, the primitive of c*delta^(n)(t-a) is c*delta^(n-1)(t-a), with zero regular part. A scalar integral or average is defined when its fixed lower and queried upper boundaries are regular. A singular fixed lower boundary is refused; a running upper singularity is typed separately and does not poison later regular values. Empty integrals retain zero.
implementation.weighted_boundaries: Exact scaled product sums coalesce same-time, same-order terms across owners before classifying support. Individually overflowing or underflowing weighted coefficients do not fabricate a nonzero or zero boundary. Order traversal follows actual records, including u32::MAX, without allocating a dense derivative jet.
implementation.live_state: Programs keep the finite current integral separately from current singular availability. Direct observations and stateless EQN/PARAM results can recover after a singular row. Published scalar traces use NaN plus valid=false at those rows; actual reads receive the boundary error before expression normalization can turn NaN into a finite sentinel. Permanent errors remain distinct.
implementation.point_queries: Direct FIND/DERIV queries inspect the exact requested time, including off-grid events, and use the regular primitive part away from support. The checked live AT result and axis metadata take precedence over offline interpolation through an invalid scalar sample.
implementation.consumer_contract: Primitive source dependencies preserve off-grid support through measure aliases and cycles. Constant IF branches are pruned only when the built-in condition is certified constant; user/statistical/file functions are not sampled. Interval consumers with unresolved primitive support explicitly refuse generalized composition instead of dropping the singular contribution. This refusal does not implement nested integration, generalized statistics or arbitrary derived-expression algebra.
implementation.unchanged_runtime: No physical event provider produces higher derivatives, the descriptor transition kernel remains cfg(test), H-family event admission remains absent and checkpoint identity remains v105.

coverage.analytic_cases: Public tests use constant finite currents and known charge steps. Derivative orders 1/2/3/128/u32::MAX, both signs and 1e300/1e-300 coefficients cover on-grid and off-grid interior events. Additional cases exercise lower/upper endpoints, empty windows, regular and singular point queries, affine weighting, cross-owner cancellation, 1e400/1e-400 intermediate weights, charge/derivative separation and cropped integration windows.
coverage.dataflow: Forward and same-row EQN references, recovery after singular rows, held final singular values, PARAM, lazy IF isolation, preserved units/AT metadata and explicit nested/off-grid consumer refusal.
coverage.cancellation: A focused regression permits the discovery pass, then aborts inside exact boundary accumulation before another complete traversal. Subsequent uncancelled boundary evaluation succeeds.
coverage.scope: Selected native public and complete measure_signals unit suite, strict core Clippy, and six optimized WASM public tests. No whole-core qualification, full symbolic distribution algebra, generalized operator-composition completion, physical CCVS solve, external-model/JIT execution, performance certification or product-readiness claim.
